_comment: M-BOOKING-CREATION test payloads — these simulate Stripe payment_intent.succeeded webhook bodies. POST a scenario object to the M-BOOKING-CREATION webhook URL. See M-BOOKING-CREATION.spec.md § Test Steps for the full procedure.
curl_example: curl -X POST "https://hook.us1.make.com/REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_M_BOOKING_CREATION_HOOK_ID" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '<paste one of the scenario objects below>'

1_happy_path_create_booking._description: Happy path — Create path: no booking_id in metadata. Stripe deposit succeeds for a new booking. Expect: new Booking record created in tbl72omPibBkn2hZL with Status=DEPOSIT_PAID, Request updated with Status=DEPOSIT_PAID and Linked_Booking_ID, M-BOOKING-CONFIRMATION triggered, BOOKING_CREATED audit event, HIGH urgency Slack alert.
1_happy_path_create_booking._test_prerequisites: An open Request record must exist in tblTlSB9CO4dTGodg with Email = 'jane.smith@example.com'. A Client record must exist in tblr84vRIWC5HmKvo with Email = 'jane.smith@example.com'. No existing Booking should have Stripe_Payment_Intent_ID = 'pi_test_create_001'.

2_happy_path_update_booking._description: Happy path — Update path: booking_id is present in metadata. A Booking record already exists (pre-created during quote/availability stage). Expect: existing Booking record updated (Status=DEPOSIT_PAID, Stripe fields set). M-BOOKING-CONFIRMATION triggered. BOOKING_UPDATED audit event.
2_happy_path_update_booking._test_prerequisites: Replace 'recBOOKINGRECORDID001' with a real Booking record ID from tbl72omPibBkn2hZL (Status should be DEPOSIT_SENT). No existing Booking should have Stripe_Payment_Intent_ID = 'pi_test_update_001'.

3_duplicate_webhook_retry._description: Idempotency guard test — Stripe retry simulation. This payload has the same Stripe Payment Intent ID as scenario 1. Expect: Route A fires (Already Processed), NO new Booking created, DUPLICATE_WEBHOOK audit event sent to M-AUDIT-LOGGER. Scenario returns 200 but does not modify Airtable.
3_duplicate_webhook_retry._test_prerequisites: Run scenario 1 first so that Stripe_Payment_Intent_ID 'pi_test_create_001' exists in the Bookings table.

4_sandbox_guard._description: Sandbox guard test — environment=sandbox. Expect: Route 1 (Sandbox Guard) fires, SANDBOX_WEBHOOK_RECEIVED audit event sent, NO Booking created or modified. Scenario returns 200.

5_me_brand_create_booking._description: Mare Executive brand — Create path. Tests brand routing for ME. Expect: new Booking created with Brand=ME, M-BOOKING-CONFIRMATION triggered with brand=ME (will send ME-branded email), BOOKING_CREATED audit event.
5_me_brand_create_booking._test_prerequisites: An open Request record must exist in tblTlSB9CO4dTGodg with Email = 'sofia.ferrari@example.com'. A Client record must exist in tblr84vRIWC5HmKvo with the same email.

6_missing_metadata_environment._description: Environment field is empty/missing in metadata — should route to Production path (Route 2 condition includes empty string). Expect: normal booking creation flow proceeds. Verifies the OR condition in Route 2 filter.
6_missing_metadata_environment._test_prerequisites: A Request and Client record must exist for 'test.noenvironment@example.com'.
